    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    cache = OrderedDict()  # Maps key -> (value, write_time)
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        t = op[1]
        
        # Remove expired entries
        expired_keys = [
            key for key, (value, write_time) in cache.items()
            if write_time + ttl <= t
        ]
        for key in expired_keys:
            del cache[key]
        
        if op[0] == 'get':
            key = op[2]
            if key in cache:
                value, write_time = cache[key]
                # Move to end (most recently used)
                cache.move_to_end(key)
                results.append(value)
            else:
                results.append(-1)
        
        elif op[0] == 'put':
            key = op[2]
            value = op[3]
            
            # If key already exists, remove it first
            if key in cache:
                del cache[key]
            # If cache is at capacity, evict LRU (first item)
            elif len(cache) >= capacity:
                cache.popitem(last=False)
            
            # Add the new entry (most recently used)
            cache[key] = (value, t)
    
    return results
